headline: Aadhar Housing Finance gets ESG rating
summary: Aadhar Housing Finance Ltd received an ESG rating of 56.00 Performer from Niche99 for FY26. The independent assessment is based on public domain data for the fiscal year.

headline: Vardhman Special Steels AGM: Dividend, Director Reappointments Approved
summary: Vardhman Special Steels Ltd shareholders approved a ₹3.5 dividend per share and reappointed directors at its 16th AGM held on September 18, 2026.

headline: Hexagon Nutrition promoter adds 10,000 shares
summary: Promoter Ms. Anuradha Kelkar acquired 10,000 equity shares of Hexagon Nutrition Ltd in the open market on September 17, 2026. Her total holding rose to 9,078,059 shares, representing a 7.38% stake in the company.

headline: Balrampur Chini Gets ESG Leader Rating
summary: Balrampur Chini Mills Ltd received an ESG rating of 72, classified as 'Leader', by SEBI-registered provider Niche99. The voluntary assessment was based on publicly available information.

headline: Dharni Capital re-appoints BSD & Co as auditors
summary: Dharni Capital Services Limited shareholders approved the re-appointment of M/s. BSD & Co as statutory auditors for five years at its AGM on September 18, 2026.

headline: Padmanabh Alloys promoter acquires 316 shares
summary: Promoter Hemal Rajeshbhai Desai acquired 316 equity shares of Padmanabh Alloys & Polymers Ltd in the open market on September 15, 2026, raising his stake to 1.759%.

headline: CMR Green Tech gets ₹165 crore credit boost
summary: CMR Green Technologies secured enhanced credit facilities from Federal Bank, raising total limits to ₹165 crore. The move includes a new factoring limit to support liquidity.

headline: CMR Green Technologies to hold investor meetings in September
summary: CMR Green Technologies Limited announced that its management will participate in analyst and institutional investor group meetings on September 23 and 29, 2026, under SEBI LODR regulations.

headline: Capital Infra Trust approves ₹125 crore for debt repayment
summary: Capital Infra Trust’s investment manager approved using ₹124.99 crore from a preferential issue to repay senior debt via shareholder loans. The board also amended the Project Management Agreement termination clause.

headline: Bright Brothers holds 79th AGM, adopts FY26 accounts
summary: Bright Brothers Limited concluded its 79th Annual General Meeting on September 18, 2026. Shareholders approved the audited financial statements for FY26 and declared a dividend. The meeting also saw the reappointment of key directors.

headline: Aeroflex Neu Board Meeting on Sep 23
summary: Aeroflex Neu Ltd schedules board meeting for September 23, 2026 to discuss expansion and new business avenues. Trading window closes for insiders.

headline: Vardhman Polytex Promoters Convert Warrants
summary: Oswal Holding Pvt Ltd converted 1.47 crore warrants into equity shares of Vardhman Polytex, completing the conversion of all outstanding preferential warrants.

headline: Sattva Sukun promoter sells 10 lakh shares
summary: Roshan Dealmark Pvt Ltd, a promoter of Sattva Sukun Lifecare Ltd (now Tavexia Lifecare), disposed of 10,00,000 equity shares on September 17, 2026. The on-market sale reduces the promoter group's holding to 4.36%.
